dateWindow.basis: ADREC market-data recent-sales endpoint date filters; not complete lifetime history

methodology: Exact ADREC project-name filter; residential full-share sale rows only. Individual transaction identifiers are not returned by the endpoint; stable hashes cover normalized source rows and duplicate ordinal. Price per square foot is computed only from full-share sale price / sold area. This is a 2019 onward endpoint window, not complete lifetime history.

termsReview.note: The public dashboard exposes project-filtered registered sales and an export control. ADREC site terms reviewed on 2026-10-22 did not state a data-reuse licence. Keep this batch in the unmerged research candidate pending rights review; do not publish or deploy it.
